chunks: And in the narration of Hariz, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who arrived in Mecca at the time of the Asr prayer, he said: “He should begin with the Asr prayer, then perform tawaf.”

key_terms.حَرِيزٍ: Hariz, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Mecca, the sacred sanctuary and site of pilgrimage rites
key_terms.يَطُوفُ: he performs tawaf around the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: If someone arrives in Mecca at the time of Asr, should he pray first or perform tawaf first?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who arrives in Mecca at the time of the Asr prayer. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام instructs that he should first perform the Asr prayer and then perform tawaf, indicating the precedence of the obligatory salat in this circumstance.
